name: oot-intel-igpu
description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Intel integrated graphics (Arc / Xe).
_comment_env: Leave env EMPTY until a switch has a measured gain: a switch is added here only with valid rows of suites/igpu-switches.json (in results/) that show it faster or cooler than the baseline on the same machine, with scene_ok true. Name the rows in the commit that adds it.
_comment_power_policy: Optional powercfg processor settings (AC values) for the session, e.g. {"PERFBOOSTMODE": 0, "PROCTHROTTLEMIN": 5, "PROCTHROTTLEMIN1": 5}. Empty for the same reason as env; pass --power-policy on the command line to try one.
